item.title: Production Desk 1.5.10
item.description:
Production Desk 1.5.10

  • Load The Last Light from the sidebar to explore an editable eight-scene production with sixteen shots, two planning scenarios and three shoot days.
  • Follow the demo guide through screenplay breakdown, scheduling, shot lists, reports and an eight-page original lined script with twelve editable marks.
  • Export the matching Scenic project and shot-list CSV to compare camera setups, blocking and coverage across both apps.
  • Reopening the managed demo preserves edits. Reset affects only that demo and supports cancellation and Undo; imported copies and existing productions remain separate.
  • The fictional demo is included temporarily for beta testing and reference. Its entry point will be removed before production. Existing portable files and desktop update safeguards remain available.
